findings.summary: The source manifest and qualification still bind r002; 16 listed members drift, 19 current members are absent, and the frozen test denominator is 30 instead of 37.
The staged wheel exposes Pippi but omits Mosaic UI, specs, docs, and the skill; native dashboard loading fails.
The installer labels a two-file presence check as source-envelope verification and does not verify the manifest or member hashes.
The snapshot uses the mosaic-ucm 0.1.0 identity while omitting inherited release paths and is not a coherent standalone publication tree.
P/PPI and the canonical UCM workspace require an explicit hash-bound delta merge rather than a directory overwrite.
Review evidence, captures, and temporary residue should remain outside the runtime artifact.
